title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: whereas a comprehensive ‘Health in All Policies’ approach, as enshrined in Article 168 TFEU, requires the systematic integration of health considerations, including prevention, while addressing the social, economic and environmental determinants of health across all EU policies in line with the One Health and exposome approach[[24]](#footnote-25);
